admissionRules.additionalCriteria: Undergraduate Honors admission: total GPA 5 with minimum 2.5 either in SSC or HSC/equivalent; alternatively, a student with minimum GPA 2.00 in SSC/HSC/equivalent and total GPA 6.00 or above may apply, except B.Pharm. scholarships.title: First-semester GPA-based scholarship
scholarships.description: Prime University first-semester GPA-based scholarship: combined SSC+HSC GPA 10.00 = 100% tuition waiver. The page also displays 9.00-9.99 = 75%, 8.00-8.99 = 50%, and 7.00-7.99 = 25%, but explicitly states that the intermediate 7.00-9.99 slabs are indicative while the GPA 10.00 to 100% rule is university policy.

eligibility.caveat: The source describes the intermediate 7.00-9.99 slabs as indicative; only the GPA 10.00 to 100% rule is stated as university policy.
